# MenuArtMode

Namespace `Nfty.Ticket` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public enum MenuArtMode
```

Whether a Menu carries its art as one atlas or as a file per variant.

## Values

- <span id="f-atlas"></span>`Atlas = 0` - Every variant stitched into one PNG, addressed by the rects in the manifest.
- <span id="f-loose"></span>`Loose = 1` - One PNG per variant, nested under `art/` by recipe, ingredient and variant — `art/<recipeId>/<ingredientId>/<variantId>.png`, the same path [`MenuBook.CellKey()`](Nfty.Ticket.MenuBook.md#m-cellkey-system-string-system-string-system-string) spells with `/` in place of the file's own separator.
